grading_rule: Do not infer enforcement from an example, deployment from a local test, or settlement from an execution receipt. A dimension is graded only on evidence that names it; anything else stays unknown.

entries.name: MCP hosts (Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop)
entries.what_we_gate: The MCP server that carries the gate, over stdio and Streamable HTTP.
entries.notes: Re-ran 2026-11-21: the stdio handshake against the published package proved initialize and tools/list (10 tools). No named host was driven and no payment was gated, so enforcement is none and the host version is unknown. The Claude Desktop, Cursor and Claude Code snippets are documented in README.md only.

entries.name: AI SDK
entries.what_we_gate: Paystage payment tools called from an AI SDK agent loop before the wallet signs.
entries.notes: Ran 2026-11-21 (5 tests pass). The tests call the generated tool execute() functions directly, which is what a model would trigger; no model loop is driven. Host version is the installed ai 6.0.332; an enforcement test exists, not a full agent run.

entries.name: elizaOS
entries.what_we_gate: The payment-evaluation action an elizaOS agent runs before signing.
entries.notes: Ran 2026-11-21 (5 tests pass). The action handler is driven with a fabricated agent message, so the enforcement point is tested; no elizaOS runtime is installed or started, so the host version is unknown.

entries.name: n8n
entries.what_we_gate: The community node that evaluates a proposed x402 payment before a workflow signs it.
entries.notes: Ran 2026-11-21 (3 tests pass). The node is driven through a fake n8n execution context and a stubbed HTTP helper; the hosted endpoint it calls is not contacted. No n8n package is installed, so the host version is unknown.

entries.name: @x402/core
entries.what_we_gate: Payment payload creation through paystageClientHook on a real x402 client.
entries.notes: Ran 2026-11-21 (37 tests in the package pass). A real @x402/core client is driven with a throwaway key; the allowed case produces a signed payload, and the denied case aborts before anything is signed.

entries.name: @x402/evm
entries.what_we_gate: The EVM scheme's createPaymentPayload call, after the gate returns pay.
entries.notes: Ran 2026-11-21 (37 tests in the package pass). ExactEvmScheme from @x402/evm signs only after the hook returns pay. The throwaway key is never funded, so this is not an on-chain payment and not a settlement.

entries.name: x402-fetch (v1, unscoped)
entries.what_we_gate: The buyer's 402 challenge before x402-fetch signs and retries.
entries.notes: Ran 2026-11-21. The test loads the optional peer and proves the no-peer message is not raised, but the signed-payment path is delegated to x402-fetch and is stubbed; nothing here proves a gated payment end to end. Graded experimental, not tested: the peer runs, the enforcement through it is unproven.

entries.name: PayMCP
entries.what_we_gate: The buyer-side evaluation of the x402 challenge PayMCP's Mode.X402 returns to the seller's tool call.
entries.notes: Prose pairing only: the page maps PayMCP's documented 402 challenge to the evaluator input. No PayMCP server was run and no payment was made, so enforcement is none and the host version is unknown. Their API may move.

entries.name: npm — @paystage/mcp
entries.what_we_gate: The published MCP server a reader installs from the registry.
entries.notes: Live probe on 2026-11-21: published version 0.8.17 matches the local package. A listing does not gate a payment, so pre-action enforcement is none even though the listing is current.

entries.name: Glama
entries.what_we_gate: The directory page that describes the server and its tools.
entries.notes: Last successful probe 2026-11-20 found all 10 tool names. On 2026-11-21 the probe failed to fetch the page, so the date stays at the last success and the page version is unknown; this is not evidence that the page changed.

entries.name: Official MCP registry
entries.what_we_gate: The registry entry that MCP hosts search and resolve.
entries.notes: Live probe on 2026-11-21: the registry entry resolves 0.8.17 and is aligned with the local package. It was behind at 0.8.15 on 2026-11-20; the republish has since landed.

entries.name: mcp.so
entries.what_we_gate: The directory page that describes the server and its tools.
entries.notes: Live probe on 2026-11-21 found 3 of 10 tool names. The page is stale; updating it is the directory's crawl, not a repo change. A listing that is behind still does not gate a payment.
